turn.content: Both issues are clear. The PO sets line 2 at 700,000 and line 4 at 2,218,000. No contract clause sets a price for these items (contract only refers to Lampiran A which doesn't override the PO), and the contract runs from 1 Jan 2026 — so any contract price would already be effective; there's no later effective date. Thus both are overcharges.
